title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 1.12
exact_target: For entire functions of infinite order whose zeros are all real, test positivity and the proposed maximal value of the deficiency at zero. The source reports Miles’s examples with deficiency zero, refuting both. \href{https://arxiv.org/abs/1809.07200}{[S2]}

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2301012 (AMR-022-1012). CC BY 4.0.

Walter K. Hayman and Eleanor F. Lingham, Research Problems in Function Theory, Fiftieth Anniversary Edition (2018), arXiv:1809.07200. Problem 1.12, its full Update 1.12, and chapter notation; original author TeX.
